title: Калибровать resource envelopes и выпустить aggregate P8 receipt
summary: Реализовать P1 workload protocol, отделить portable resource/complexity gates от host-bound timing baselines и агрегировать P8.2–P8.4 в один reproducible adversarial receipt для P9/P10.
why: Absolute latency on an arbitrary shared runner creates false RED/GREEN, while parser depth, bytes, allocations, query counts, page bounds and complexity growth remain enforceable. Independent receipts без exact manifest coverage не закрывают F10. `RAG:✅` benchmark caveat in `@plan/knowledge/research-P8-design-rag.json`.

include: P1 workload realization for canonicalization/schema/token/fingerprint/event fold/snapshot/differential/contention; boundary and growth-series inputs; process RSS/peak allocation/query-count/output-size/timeout caps where observable; PHP/Dart benchmark runners; warmup/raw samples/statistics; host/runtime/dependency fingerprint; same-fingerprint comparison bands; flake/minimization/quarantine policy; exact aggregate manifest coverage and producer receipt.
exclude: Universal latency SLO; cross-machine or PHP-vs-Dart speed comparison; hiding a correctness failure as benchmark noise; marketing claims; CI runner/schedule/workflow ownership; release artifact/SBOM/provenance; public publication.

rules: Portable gates own exact input/output byte limits, depth/count/page/query/row caps, peak-resource ceilings supported by the runtime and growth-class envelopes; they do not depend on a faster host. Timing receipt records commit, OS/kernel/arch/CPU/core/memory/container, power/governor when observable, PHP/Dart/PostgreSQL/tool/dependency versions, command/config/input digests, warmup, raw samples and summary statistics. Timing is blocking only against a reviewed baseline with matching fingerprint and workload digest; otherwise it is labeled `informational`/`baseline_pending`. Dart `benchmark_harness` is exact-lock dev tooling, and its one-call exercise semantics are explicit. PHP and Dart timing are never compared. Critical correctness rows cannot be quarantined; any noncritical quarantine names owner, lost coverage, reason and expiry. One rerun may classify infrastructure noise only with unchanged seed/fingerprint and both raw attempts retained.
guidance: Run each workload in a fresh bounded subprocess where possible. Stream corpora and measure before/at/over-bound inputs plus geometric size series so superlinear regressions are visible without trusting one timestamp. Keep contention timing separate from storage correctness. Aggregate by exact `AV-###` sets and child receipt digests; never sum semantic, mutation, fuzz, storage and performance results into one percentage. Emit one producer-readiness candidate for P9/P10 only when every applicable critical row is green.
deliverables: Calibrated portable resource gates, host-bound benchmark baseline with raw evidence, explicit flake/quarantine policy and aggregate P8 adversarial receipt ready for P9 automation and P10 acceptance.

sections.title: Validation
sections.text: Every P1 `RL-*`/workload has a measured gate or explicit `baseline_pending` owner accepted by its contract; over-limit and growth mutants make portable gates red; same-fingerprint repeated baseline stays inside its declared robust-statistics band while fingerprint mismatch refuses a timing verdict; raw samples reproduce summaries; critical quarantine and expired quarantine are rejected; aggregate has `missing=[]`, `extra=[]`, `stale=[]`, preserves separate evidence namespaces and verifies child digests; one stale/mutated child receipt makes aggregate red; existing PHP/Dart/conformance/package gates remain green; no workflow/release files change; plan lint adds no ERROR.
